Image 2.6 support for the Codex Plugin and Standalone Skill.

## Highlights

- Add GIF/SVG output, markup edits, and complexity controls, with Sunburst and Flare configuration examples.
- Fix GIF/SVG storage recovery and Windows folder reveal.
- Preserve redacted provider errors in image jobs.
- Check configured image-size limits before API requests.

## Install

Update the Codex Plugin through its Git marketplace, or download:

- `openai-compatible-imagegen-codex-plugin-1.7.0.zip`
- `openai-compatible-imagegen-skill-1.7.0.zip`

Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS`. See [installation](https://github.com/Syh1906/openai-compatible-imagegen/blob/v1.7.0/docs/guides/installation.md) or [updating](https://github.com/Syh1906/openai-compatible-imagegen/blob/v1.7.0/docs/guides/updating.md). Restart Codex App after updating the Plugin. Existing configurations remain valid.

## Known limitations

- GIF/SVG and markup require provider support. SVG generation remains unverified; some accounts require `parameters.svg.model`. See [model configuration](https://github.com/Syh1906/openai-compatible-imagegen/blob/v1.7.0/docs/guides/models.md#gpt-image-26-gif-svg-and-markup).
- GIF/SVG support preview and original export only. Local pixel processing requires supported PNG inputs.
- Markup does not guarantee unchanged pixels outside annotations. API model and format controls do not apply to the ChatGPT route.
- Older jobs cannot recover missing error details. Unknown requests are not retried automatically.
- **Show in folder** is Windows-only.
